title: expendit.compute.requested
description: common (outbox) -> analytics compute. Every number the product shows that is not a plain sum: statement validation, ratios, tax estimates, filing figures, the dashboard AI summary. `inputs` carries everything the computation reads. Key: org id (so one org's requests stay ordered).

data_version.description: The org's data version when the request was made; results for an older version are dropped by common.

inputs.description: Kind-specific. statement_validation: {statement_id, kind, mapping_version, line_items[]}. ratios: {period, statements{kind: line_items[]}, previous?}. tax_estimate / filing: {profile, category_treatments, ledger_totals, period_bounds}. dashboard_summary: {totals, by_category, trends}.
